answer: Quadratic staking lock-up forces each validator to commit onyx collateral that scales as the square of its delegated stake, turning any Sybil split into a convex cost curve. A jade verifiable delay function binds slashing to a zero-knowledge proof of elapsed time, making penalties deterministic and unavoidable. The grove of slashing thresholds escalates super-linearly with each added identity, so marginal attack expense exceeds any extractable reward and establishes a negative expected utility Nash equilibrium.
